spans.s: Uttered, spoken (opp. to अनुमित or संभावित).
Told, addressed; असावनुक्तो ऽपि सहाय एव
Indicated; असता छाययोक्ताय सदाभासाय ते नमः

+ .{@-क्तम्, -क्ता@} A stanza of four lines with one syllabic instant,
 (there being one long or two short syllables in each).
.━{@Comp.@}: उक्तानुक्त, उक्तोपसंहारः, उक्तनिर्वाहः, उक्तपुंस्कः, उक्तप्रत्युक्तम्, उक्तवर्जम्, उक्तवाक्यम्
+ .{@-क्तम्@} A speech, words collectively; a sentence.

+ .{@-क्तम्, -क्ता@} A stanza of four lines with one syllabic instant,
 (there being one long or two short syllables in each).
.━{@Comp.@}: उक्तानुक्त, उक्तोपसंहारः, उक्तनिर्वाहः, उक्तपुंस्कः, उक्तप्रत्युक्तम्, उक्तवर्जम्, उक्तवाक्यम्
+ -उपसंहारः a brief description, resume, peroration, recapitulation.

+ -पुंस्कः a word (feminine or neuter) of which also a masculine
 exists, and the meaning of which differs from that of the masculine only
 by the notion of gender.
Speech, expression, statement; उक्तिरर्थान्तरन्यासः स्यात् सामान्यविशेषयोः

The power of expression, the expressive power of a word; as in एकयोक्त्या
 पुष्पवन्तौ दिवाकरनिशाकरौ Ak.
A worthy speech or word, maxim.
